(a) Spend the first morning exploring the city’s Chinatown district, tasting traditional pastries while taking in the historic architecture. In the afternoon, join a guided walking tour focused on East Asian heritage sites. Wrap up by enjoying a multi-course dim sum dinner at a highly rated local restaurant.
(b) Spend the first morning walking the city on foot with your camera, capturing architectural details and candid street scenes before the crowds arrive. In the afternoon, join a local photography walk or workshop to discover hidden vantage points. Wrap up by visiting a rooftop bar or scenic overlook for golden hour shots and a panoramic view of the skyline.
(c) Spend the first morning wandering through the city’s main attractions and exploring local landmarks. In the afternoon, join a guided tour or activity to get insider knowledge from a resident. Wrap up with a nice dinner and a walk to a scenic viewpoint to watch the sunset over the city.
(d) Spend the first morning exploring the city’s specialty tea houses, sampling rare blends while learning about their origins from local experts. In the afternoon, join a guided tea and dessert pairing tour to experience the cultural side of the city. Wrap up with a sunset tea ceremony at a historic venue for a unique sensory finale.
